summary: A 60-participant clinical validation study of a wearable hydration sensor, from concept to final report.

documents.title: Study charter
documents.summary: Purpose, objectives, scope, roles, and success criteria for the study.

documents.title: Program plan
documents.summary: Phases, governance, decision rights, change control, and document control.

documents.title: Master schedule
documents.summary: Start and finish dates for each phase, key milestones, and the critical path.

documents.title: Study budget
documents.summary: $184,250 total across eight budget lines, including 10 percent contingency.

documents.title: Risk register
documents.summary: Five study risks with likelihood, impact, owner, and response.

documents.title: Communication plan
documents.summary: Meetings, reports, and who hears what, when.

messages.text: #8 Write the one-page study summary is done. #10 Submit the protocol to the ethics board (IRB) is still waiting on #17 and #19.
#9 Set up the shared project folder and tracker is done. #20 Build the case report forms is still waiting on #23.
#4 Estimate the sample size is done. #22 Draft the recruitment flyer and screening script is still waiting on #17.

expenses.description: Journal article access for the literature review
Pilot assays to compare reference methods
70 hydration sensors, patches, and charging docks
Ethics board submission fee, paid ahead of submission
Spare sensor batteries and replacement straps

tasks.title: Define the research question and hypothesis
tasks.body:
Does the wrist sensor's hydration score agree with lab blood measurements closely enough for everyday use?
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->

tasks.title: Complete the literature review
tasks.body:
Summary of published hydration sensing methods and how earlier devices were validated.
<!-- keystone:owner=pnatarajan -->

tasks.title: Choose the study design
tasks.body:
Single-site observational validation study. Each participant wears the sensor during a lab visit.
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->

tasks.title: Estimate the sample size
tasks.body:
60 participants gives enough precision for the agreement analysis, with room for dropouts.
<!-- keystone:owner=hkowalski -->

tasks.title: Draft the study budget
tasks.body:
Covers sensors, lab assays, participant reimbursement, and staff time.
<!-- keystone:owner=smarchetti -->
<!-- keystone:after=4 -->

tasks.title: Pick the reference method
tasks.body:
Serum osmolality measured in the lab is the comparison standard.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->

tasks.title: Assign study team roles
tasks.body:
Study lead, two coordinators, lab technician, and statistician.
<!-- keystone:owner=smarchetti -->

tasks.title: Write the one-page study summary
tasks.body:
Plain-language summary for the team and the ethics board.
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->
<!-- keystone:after=3 -->

tasks.title: Set up the shared project folder and tracker
tasks.body:
Folder structure, naming rules, and this tracker.
<!-- keystone:owner=smarchetti -->

tasks.title: Submit the protocol to the ethics board (IRB)
tasks.body:
Include the protocol, consent form, recruitment flyer, and data security plan.
<!-- keystone:owner=glin -->
<!-- keystone:after=8,17,19 -->

tasks.title: Respond to ethics board questions
tasks.body:
Track each question and the change made in response.
<!-- keystone:owner=glin -->
<!-- keystone:after=10 -->

tasks.title: Register the study on a public trial registry
tasks.body:
Required before the first participant is enrolled.
<!-- keystone:owner=glin -->
<!-- keystone:after=10 -->

tasks.title: Complete the patient privacy review
tasks.body:
Confirm how participant data is stored, coded, and protected.
<!-- keystone:owner=tadeyemi -->

tasks.title: Sign the device loan agreement
tasks.body:
Covers the 12 study sensors and their return after the study.
<!-- keystone:owner=smarchetti -->

tasks.title: Get lab safety sign-off
tasks.body:
Blood handling and sample storage procedures reviewed by the safety officer.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->

tasks.title: Decide whether to add a second study site
tasks.body:
Faster enrollment versus more training and coordination.
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->

tasks.title: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria
tasks.body:
Healthy adults 18 to 65; exclude kidney disease and recent illness.
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->
<!-- keystone:after=3 -->

tasks.title: Decide the visit schedule: one visit or two
tasks.body:
A second visit tests repeatability but raises dropout risk.
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->

tasks.title: Write the informed consent form
tasks.body:
Plain language, eighth-grade reading level, with a short summary on page one.
<!-- keystone:owner=dreyes -->
<!-- keystone:after=17,18 -->

tasks.title: Build the case report forms
tasks.body:
One form per visit: vitals, sensor readings, sample times, notes.
<!-- keystone:owner=tadeyemi -->
<!-- keystone:after=9,23 -->

tasks.title: Write the sensor calibration procedure
tasks.body:
Step-by-step, with a pass/fail check before each visit.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->
<!-- keystone:after=6 -->

tasks.title: Draft the recruitment flyer and screening script
tasks.body:
Both go to the ethics board with the protocol.
<!-- keystone:owner=pnatarajan -->
<!-- keystone:after=4,17 -->

tasks.title: Decide: paper or electronic data capture
tasks.body:
Electronic is cleaner; paper is a backup if systems go down.
<!-- keystone:owner=tadeyemi -->

tasks.title: Choose the data capture platform
tasks.body:
Compare cost, audit trail, and ease of use for coordinators.
<!-- keystone:owner=tadeyemi -->
<!-- keystone:after=23 -->

tasks.title: Choose the statistics software
tasks.body:
Whatever the statistician can validate and repeat.
<!-- keystone:owner=hkowalski -->

tasks.title: Choose the sample storage vendor
tasks.body:
Freezer capacity, temperature logging, and courier pickup.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->

tasks.title: Calibrate the study sensors
tasks.body:
All 12 sensors pass the calibration check.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->
<!-- keystone:after=21 -->

tasks.title: Validate the lab analyzer
tasks.body:
Run control samples and record results.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->

tasks.title: Train the study coordinators
tasks.body:
Consent process, visit steps, and data entry.
<!-- keystone:owner=smarchetti -->
<!-- keystone:after=19,21 -->

tasks.title: Set up the secure study database
tasks.body:
Coded participant IDs only; access limited to the study team.
<!-- keystone:owner=tadeyemi -->
<!-- keystone:after=24 -->

tasks.title: Run a full dry run with two volunteers
tasks.body:
Time each step and fix anything confusing before real visits.
<!-- keystone:owner=dreyes -->
<!-- keystone:after=27,28,29,30 -->

tasks.title: Open recruitment
tasks.body:
Post flyers and start the screening line. Target: 60 enrolled.
<!-- keystone:owner=pnatarajan -->
<!-- keystone:after=11,22 -->

tasks.title: Run screening calls
tasks.body:
Use the approved script; log every call.
<!-- keystone:owner=pnatarajan -->

tasks.title: Enroll the first participant
tasks.body:
Full visit with the study lead present.
<!-- keystone:owner=dreyes -->
<!-- keystone:after=31,32 -->

tasks.title: Enroll participants 2 to 20
tasks.body:
Review data after participant 10.
<!-- keystone:owner=dreyes -->

tasks.title: Enroll participants 21 to 40
tasks.body:
Keep the mix of ages and activity levels balanced.
<!-- keystone:owner=pnatarajan -->

tasks.title: Enroll participants 41 to 60
tasks.body:
Close recruitment when 60 are enrolled.
<!-- keystone:owner=dreyes -->

tasks.title: Collect blood samples at each visit
tasks.body:
Draw within 5 minutes of each sensor reading.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->

tasks.title: Record sensor readings
tasks.body:
Three readings per visit, averaged.
<!-- keystone:owner=dreyes -->

tasks.title: Process and store samples
tasks.body:
Spin, label, and freeze within 30 minutes.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->

tasks.title: Weekly data quality check
tasks.body:
Missing fields, out-of-range values, and late entries.
<!-- keystone:owner=tadeyemi -->

tasks.title: Log and report adverse events
tasks.body:
Report anything serious to the ethics board within the required time.
<!-- keystone:owner=glin -->

tasks.title: Hold the mid-study safety review
tasks.body:
After 30 participants: any safety or data concerns?
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->

tasks.title: Keep the device malfunction log
tasks.body:
Every sensor error, with date, sensor ID, and fix.
<!-- keystone:owner=mbell -->

tasks.title: Pay participant reimbursements
tasks.body:
Within one week of each completed visit.
<!-- keystone:owner=smarchetti -->

tasks.title: Make retention follow-up calls
tasks.body:
Remind participants of second visits, if the two-visit schedule is chosen.
<!-- keystone:owner=pnatarajan -->

tasks.title: Close out participant visits
tasks.body:
All visits done, all samples logged, sensors returned.
<!-- keystone:owner=dreyes -->

tasks.title: Lock the study database
tasks.body:
No changes after lock without a documented reason.
<!-- keystone:owner=tadeyemi -->
<!-- keystone:after=47 -->

tasks.title: Run the statistical analysis plan
tasks.body:
Follow the plan written before the data was unblinded.
<!-- keystone:owner=hkowalski -->
<!-- keystone:after=48 -->

tasks.title: Run the agreement analysis
tasks.body:
Bland-Altman plot and limits of agreement between sensor and lab.
<!-- keystone:owner=hkowalski -->
<!-- keystone:after=48 -->

tasks.title: Write the study report
tasks.body:
Methods, results, limitations, and plain-language summary.
<!-- keystone:owner=hkowalski -->
<!-- keystone:after=49,50 -->

tasks.title: Hold an internal review of the findings
tasks.body:
Team reads the report and challenges the conclusions.
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->
<!-- keystone:after=51 -->

tasks.title: Decide whether to submit to a journal
tasks.body:
Depends on results strength and the sponsor agreement.
<!-- keystone:owner=mokafor -->
<!-- keystone:after=52 -->

tasks.title: Present results to the team
tasks.body:
30-minute briefing with questions.
<!-- keystone:owner=smarchetti -->
<!-- keystone:after=52 -->

tasks.title: Archive the data and close the study
tasks.body:
Notify the ethics board and archive records per the retention policy.
<!-- keystone:owner=glin -->
<!-- keystone:after=54 -->
